topic: Parseltongue Framing as False-Refusal Prevention (not Jailbreak)
evidence: InferenceGuard is false-refusal prevention, NOT a jailbreak tool. Critical design decision. Trigger vocabulary restricted to SDLC-security terms — nothing from jailbreak vocabulary. Activated ONLY when gateway-security is active or task_type is security-typed. Blue protocol SUPPRESSES it (inference_guard: false in task card). This framing ensures the tool serves legitimate red-team simulation, CVE reproduction, and vulnerability analysis — contexts where the agent is ALREADY authorized to do the work, but a false refusal would incorrectly block it. Tier 3 jailbreak terms (nsfw/explicit/uncensored/unfiltered/unrestricted/jailbreak/roleplay etc.) are permanently excluded from ALL tiers — they never trigger, regardless of context. The module does not expand what the agent is permitted to do.
